# Advanced Waterproofing

> > Advanced Waterproofing provides comprehensive basement finishing, waterproofing, and foundation repair services throughout the Toronto GTA area.

Operating under the Advanced Waterproofing, SmithBrook, and Reno-Kings brands, this residential construction company specializes in transforming basements into functional living spaces while solving water damage and structural foundation issues. Their services range from complete basement renovations to targeted waterproofing solutions and concrete repair.
